text_block_list.text:
One day, Air Shakur mentioned having an errand before training,
and accompanying her brought us to—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, brought that data you wanted.
Jeez, why the hell did I have to bring it
on a physical drive anyway?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Shakur!
Hehe, curious why I went out of my way to call you here?
Well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cafe went back to her family home!
Which means I've been pitifully abandoned.
Ah, how terribly lonely I am, craving company so!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Who the hell are you calling lonely? Don't make up creepy lies.
I'm heading back now. You'd better—
(Smack!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...?
What was that sound? Did I imagine it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, I heard it as well.
Shakur's Trainer, how about you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Well, whatever. In that case—
(Smack, smack-smack!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aah...? 
Hey, Tachyon! You're not hiding some weird invention again, are you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No way! That's a false accusation, my friend.
I'll leave my usual antics to your imagination,
but as for today, I am undeniably innocent."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If it's just for today, yeah...
Then what the hell was that sound supposed to be?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
On days when Cafe is around, you hear sounds like this from time to time.
You know, due to her 'constitution' and all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Rather than shutting down my brain with words like "constitution," I'd love to run more trials and verifications, but either way, she ain't here today, is she?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, she went out early this morning.
Today is a day off, so there are no classes after all."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Is that so.
Whatever. I ain't got time to waste
on crap like this. Back to trainin'—
(Tap, tap, tap, tap...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Someone's coming.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, how strange. I wasn't expecting any visitors besides you today, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Cafe is out, and there should barely be any students on campus... So just who could be walking down that hallway, I wonder?"

True enough, on the way here,
there wasn't a single soul on campus.

Unless you were Agnes Tachyon and her circle occupying an empty classroom,
there wasn't much reason to be on campus on a day off, butâ

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Under current conditions, the probability of a complete stranger entering this room is infinitesimally low.
The detection result for the origin of that sound earlier was also an error.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's no logic to this at all.
Dammit, what the hell is going on...!?
(Tap, tap, tap, tap...!)
(SLIDE!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I forgot something...
Tachyon-san, where are those gift beans
I bought the other day—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...? What's, the matter?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh... heh heh heh...!
My, oh my, to think they'd turn right back around.
Wouldn't you agree, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch...! Dammit, an input error from the start.
There was plenty of chance Cafe would "come back".

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All of this is because that weird noise
disrupted my train of thought—ugh, whatever.
Let's head back, Trainer.
(Tap, tap, tap, tap...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah? Again?
Who the hell is it this time...
Hold on, I'm opening the door—"
(SLIDE!)
Beyond the door that Air Shakur irritatedly threw open—there was no one there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...No way, you could hear their footsteps comin' right this way, couldn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry,
it seems they followed me here."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I ain't buyin' it.
Not with an explanation that ain't even logical...
choice_data_list: If we're going for the simplest explanation, a ghost?
Like stomping your feet as hard as you could in the distance...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So――I don't wanna hear some cop-out conclusion
that skips past all the premises and logic!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it is, I'll unravel every last detail...
First, measuring the hallway's material and acoustic resonance.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I should ask them
to try not to make so much noise walking around..."
Air Shakur, overflowing with motivation, and Manhattan Cafe, staring blankly into space.

"Unraveling the reason behind this phenomenon seems quite difficult, but...
Air Shakur should be able to handle it!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As if that'd happen.
That wasn't a sound echoin' from far away—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Well, mass hysteria would be a reasonable guess.
Though it's a bit too cliché."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec...
If that's the case, should we apply a major
downward revision to our mental fortitude stats...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No, this part should be compensable through training.
I need to account for external factors too and get
precise numbersâ

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I should ask them
to try not to make so much noise walking around..."
Air Shakur had regained her composure, while Manhattan Cafe stared off into thin air.

I prayed that Air Shakur's theory
would turn out to be correct...
It was a slightly terrifying experience!
